title: cstar-mbj: machine-learned Tran-Blaha mBJ exchange parameter for near-experimental band gaps
description: Dataset (177 materials, 149 clean), PBEsol-relaxed structures, trained model (Gaussian process + random forest), prediction tool, and automated pipeline for predicting the material-specific optimal TB-mBJ parameter c* from inexpensive PBE descriptors, so that a single meta-GGA calculation yields a near-experimental band gap.
